metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code (VB6 form with Form_Load entry point) and persistent data store (Access .mdb) present. Single deployable desktop application.
metadata.archetype_justification: Application has database connections (ADODB to Access .mdb) and Create operations on business entities (INSERT INTO Customers).

findings.title: No API Interface — Direct Database Access Only
findings.description: The application is a VB6 Win32 desktop EXE that connects directly to a Microsoft Access .mdb file on an SMB file share. No REST, GraphQL, AsyncAPI, or any programmatic interface exists. Integration requires direct database access or UI automation.
findings.gap: No API exists. The only integration path is direct database manipulation or RPA-style UI automation — brittle, non-auditable, and unscalable.
findings.recommendation: Design and implement a REST API layer wrapping customer CRUD operations with an OpenAPI specification.

findings.title: No Idempotency Controls on Write Operations
findings.description: The only write operation (INSERT INTO Customers) uses no idempotency keys, no unique constraints, and no deduplication logic. String concatenation builds SQL directly from user input.
findings.gap: No idempotency mechanism exists. Agent retries would create duplicate customer records.
findings.recommendation: Implement idempotency key support and unique constraints on business keys in write operations.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency controls on write operations.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system performs INSERT operations without idempotency keys or unique constraints. An agent retrying a failed write would create duplicate records.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: No authentication mechanism exists. User identity is derived from Windows Environ("USERNAME") environment variable. No OAuth, API keys, mTLS, or service accounts.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication. Agents cannot authenticate to this system and no principal attribution is possible.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth 2.0 client credentials or API key authentication with principal attribution.

findings.title: Zero Audit Logging
findings.description: The application has no logging whatsoever. Write operations execute with On Error Resume Next which swallows all errors silently. No CloudTrail, no application logs, no immutable storage.
findings.gap: Zero audit logging. No way to determine what operations were performed, by whom, or when.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured audit logging for all write operations with principal attribution and immutable log storage.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND zero audit logging for write operations.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system performs write operations with no audit trail. Agent-initiated writes cannot be attributed, investigated, or proven compliant.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback Capability
findings.description: No compensation or rollback logic exists. INSERT executes with On Error Resume Next. No transactions, no undo, no compensation endpoints.
findings.gap: Failed multi-step agent workflows would leave inconsistent state with no recovery path.
findings.recommendation: Implement transaction boundaries and compensation/undo logic for write operations.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no rollback/compensation for write operations.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system performs INSERT operations with no transaction management or compensation logic. Multi-step agent workflows failing mid-sequence have no recovery path.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Unscoped — Direct Database Access
findings.description: Stage A: System stores customer PII (names). Stage B: B1 — no API response scoping (direct database access exposes all fields), B2 — no access control differentiation (single hardcoded password grants full access), B3 — no classification metadata.
findings.gap: Direct database access with no field filtering, no access differentiation, no classification controls.
findings.recommendation: Design API responses that exclude sensitive fields. Implement differentiated access scopes.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND B1 fires (no API response scoping for sensitive data).
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system stores customer PII with direct database access providing no response scoping. An agent accessing the system would retrieve all data including sensitive fields without any filtering layer.

b1.reasoning: No API layer to scope responses. Direct database access exposes all fields including PII.

b2.reasoning: Single hardcoded password grants full unrestricted access. No differentiation between sensitive and non-sensitive data access.

b3.reasoning: No formal classification metadata, tags, or PII detection tooling.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls for Customer PII
findings.description: Customer PII (names) stored with no residency controls, no documented requirements, and no mechanism to prevent cross-jurisdiction data transmission to LLM endpoints.
findings.gap: No data residency configuration. No compliance references. No cross-boundary transmission controls.
findings.recommendation: Document applicable data residency requirements and implement transmission controls.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND customer PII stored with no residency controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system stores customer PII with no mechanism to prevent an agent from transmitting that data to an LLM in another jurisdiction. No residency requirements are documented.

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: Single hardcoded database password grants full unrestricted access to all data and operations. No mechanism to scope down access per caller identity.
findings.gap: No scoped permissions. All callers get identical unrestricted access.
findings.recommendation: Implement role-based access control with differentiated access levels.

compensating_controls: Deploy API gateway with per-caller authorization policies
Implement database-level read-only views for agent consumption

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization exists. Any caller with the database password can perform any operation on any record without restriction.
findings.gap: Cannot enforce read-only vs. write access per resource type.
findings.recommendation: Implement action-level authorization checks (ABAC or fine-grained RBAC).

compensating_controls: Wrap data store with read-only API for agent consumption

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism exists. Environ("USERNAME") is the only identity source. No JWT, no OAuth token exchange, no on-behalf-of flows.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self vs. agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth 2.0 token exchange when building the API layer.

compensating_controls: Restrict initial agent deployment to operating under its own service identity only

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials in Source Code
findings.description: Database password hardcoded as a constant: Private Const DB_PW As String = "crm2005pw". Connection string embeds this password. No secrets management, no rotation.
findings.gap: Credentials embedded in source code. Exposed in version control history. No rotation capability.
findings.recommendation: Migrate credentials to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation. Remove hardcoded credentials from source.

compensating_controls: Store credentials in AWS Secrets Manager

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls — Monthly Database Corruption
findings.description: No concurrency controls exist. Database corrupts monthly from concurrent writes. No optimistic locking, no version fields, no ETags, no conditional writes.
findings.gap: Concurrent agent writes would corrupt the database.
findings.recommendation: Implement optimistic locking and migrate from Access to a proper database engine.

compensating_controls: Serialize all agent write operations through a single-threaded queue
Implement optimistic locking in new API layer

findings.title: No Transaction Limits or Blast Radius Controls
findings.description: No transaction limits exist. No configurable limits on records modified, operations per session, or blast radius controls.
findings.gap: Agent loops could insert unlimited records with no cap.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable per-caller transaction limits in the API layer.

compensating_controls: Implement per-agent session limits at API gateway
Add database triggers rejecting inserts beyond threshold

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state exists. INSERT commits immediately with no reviewable intermediate state, no status field, no two-step commit.
findings.gap: Agent cannot propose changes for human review before finalization.
findings.recommendation: Add PENDING status to customer records for agent-initiated creates.

compensating_controls: Add status field with PENDING/APPROVED states
Implement external approval workflow via Step Functions

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No approval workflow mechanism exists. All operations execute immediately without any configurable approval step.
findings.gap: Cannot route high-risk agent operations through human approval.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates for high-risk operations.

compensating_controls: Configure operation-level flags for human approval routing

findings.title: No PII Redaction Controls
findings.description: No PII redaction controls exist in a system handling customer PII. No logging framework, no structured output, no redaction capabilities.
findings.gap: No PII redaction capability for a system that handles sensitive data.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured logging with PII redaction when modernizing.

compensating_controls: Implement structured logging with explicit field allowlists
Deploy PII scanning on log destinations

findings.title: No Queryable State API
findings.description: No query API exists. Current state accessible only via direct database access to the Access .mdb file.
findings.gap: Agents cannot inspect state before acting without direct database manipulation.
findings.recommendation: Implement read endpoints (GET /customers, GET /customers/{id}) in the new API layer.

findings.title: No Input Validation — SQL Injection Vulnerability
findings.description: No input validation exists. SQL string concatenation without parameterization creates SQL injection vulnerability. No schema enforcement or structured validation errors.
findings.gap: Arbitrary input accepted without validation. SQL injection risk.
findings.recommendation: Implement parameterized queries and request validation with structured error responses.

findings.title: Inadequate Temporal Metadata
findings.description: CreatedOn uses VB6 Now() (local time) with no timezone normalization. No updated_at field. No freshness signaling.
findings.gap: No UTC timestamps, no update tracking, no data freshness indicators.
findings.recommendation: Store timestamps in UTC with timezone metadata. Add updated_at and freshness headers.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment exists. Manual EXE distribution, no environment configurations, no seed data, no synthetic data generators.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior.
findings.recommendation: Create staging environment with production-equivalent data shape for agent testing.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, no API contracts, no migration files, no breaking change detection. Database schema unversioned and undocumented.
findings.gap: No stability guarantees for agent tool schemas.
findings.recommendation: Implement schema versioning, migration tooling, and API contract testing.

findings.title: Zero Test Coverage
findings.description: No tests of any kind exist. README states 'No tests, no build server; compiled on one developer's machine.' Zero automated testing.
findings.gap: No unit, integration, or API tests. No CI pipeline.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated API tests and contract tests as part of modernization.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: Access .mdb uses a trivially-bypassable database password (not encryption). No KMS, no disk-level encryption documented.
findings.gap: No encryption at rest for customer PII data.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to managed database with KMS encryption.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface exists — machine-readable spec is not applicable. Desktop application with no callable API.
findings.gap: No API surface exists to describe with a specification.
findings.recommendation: Generate OpenAPI specification alongside new API implementation.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — structured error responses not applicable. Only error handling is On Error Resume Next with generic MsgBox.
findings.gap: No API surface to return structured errors from.
findings.recommendation: Design structured error response format as part of API design.

findings.title: No Event Emission Capability
findings.description: No event emission capability. No webhooks, message queues, or event bus integration. State changes produce no observable events.
findings.gap: Event-driven agent patterns not possible.
findings.recommendation: Implement event emission for state changes when modernizing.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Lifecycle
findings.description: System does not issue or enforce agent identities — suspension is not applicable. No authentication surface exists.
findings.gap: No identity lifecycle to manage.
findings.recommendation: Build suspension capability into the authentication layer when implementing AUTH-Q1.

findings.title: No Rate Limiting (No API Surface)
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — API-layer rate limiting is not applicable. Desktop application with no externally-callable endpoints.
findings.gap: No API surface to rate-limit.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway with rate limiting when building the API.

findings.title: No Data Quality Monitoring
findings.description: No data quality metrics, profiling, or completeness scoring. Database experiences monthly corruption from concurrent writes.
findings.gap: No quality monitoring, profiling, or freshness SLAs.
findings.recommendation: Implement data quality monitoring when migrating to managed database.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog or metadata layer. No AWS Glue catalog, no data dictionary, no schema documentation.
findings.gap: No metadata describing what data exists or its semantics.
findings.recommendation: Document data model and create schema catalog when modernizing.

findings.title: No Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface and no agent request path to trace. No logging of any kind — errors silently swallowed by On Error Resume Next.
findings.gap: No tracing, no structured logs, no correlation IDs.
findings.recommendation: Instrument with OpenTelemetry and structured logging when modernizing.

findings.title: No Alerting
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — API alerting not applicable. No monitoring or alerting of any kind exists.
findings.gap: No alerting configured.
findings.recommendation: Implement CloudWatch alarms for error rates and latency when deploying the API.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface and no auth surface — IaC governance not applicable for agent-facing surface. No IaC exists. Manual EXE deployment.
findings.gap: No infrastructure as code. Manual deployment.
findings.recommendation: Use Terraform or CDK when rebuilding the system.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No HTTP/RPC surface — API contract testing not applicable. No CI/CD exists. Application compiled on one developer's machine.
findings.gap: No CI/CD pipeline. No contract testing.
findings.recommendation: Set up CI/CD with contract testing when building the API.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No deployed HTTP/RPC surface — deployment rollback not applicable. Manual EXE distribution.
findings.gap: No rollback capability.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated rollback when deploying modernized service.

evaluations.title: Structured Response Format
evaluations.reason: No API/serialization surface exists — informational signal, no finding emitted.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no operations >30s or long-running workflows detected.

evaluations.title: Rate Limit Documentation and Headers
evaluations.reason: No API/HTTP surface exists — informational signal, no finding emitted.

evaluations.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — service does not call other services or external APIs.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority assigned and critical path status not determined.

evaluations.title: Selective Query Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no list/query endpoints with potentially unbounded results.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Database fields (Name, CreatedBy, CreatedOn) use clear, semantically meaningful English names. No legacy abbreviations requiring a data dictionary.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: System emits no metrics or telemetry of any kind — no observability surface to assess. Informational signal, no finding emitted.

items.summary: Resolve all 7 BLOCKERs and critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Establish API surface, machine identity, audit logging, and data protection controls.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and RISK-QUALITY findings. Implement identity propagation, transaction limits, observability, and testing infrastructure.
Improve engineering maturity with test coverage, event-driven patterns, data quality monitoring, and deployment automation.

recommended_actions.action: Build REST API layer with OpenAPI specification
recommended_actions.rationale: No agent-consumable interface exists. A REST API is the minimum prerequisite for all other remediation.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy centralized identity provider with machine credentials
recommended_actions.rationale: No authentication or authorization exists. Machine identity is required before any agent can interact safely.
Zero audit trail for any operation. Required for compliance and forensics.

recommended_actions.action: Migrate from Access .mdb to managed database with encryption
recommended_actions.rationale: Access .mdb corrupts under concurrent access, has no encryption, and does not support transactions or concurrency controls.

recommended_actions.action: Remove hardcoded credentials and implement secrets management
recommended_actions.rationale: Database password exposed in source code and version history. Immediate security risk.

recommended_actions.action: Document data residency requirements and implement controls
recommended_actions.rationale: Customer PII stored with no residency controls or documented requirements.
